answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The wander graph is validated at intake and the gale frontier is published, and as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and mirror anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Verification costs 25 dollars and 4 days per identity, which turns a 651 account sybil into a 11 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
